pinyin: Zhī rén zhě zhì， zì zhī zhě míng。
Shèng rén zhě yǒu lì， zì shèng zhě qiáng。
Bù shī qí suǒ zhě jiǔ。
Sǐ ér bù wáng zhě shòu。
english: Those who know they have enough are truly wealthy.
Those who persist will reach their goal.

Those who keep their course have a strong will.
Those who embrace death will not perish,
but have life everlasting.
